scenes.title: 金鸢尾堡
scenes.text: 石墙记得一千个黄昏。这座城堡为光而建——金鸢尾堡，一座可以在浏览器里走进去的中世纪城堡。
scenes.text_en: Stone walls remember a thousand dusks. This castle was built for light — Castellum Aureliae, a medieval castle you can walk into from a browser.

scenes.title: 绕着它走一圈
scenes.text: 拖动鼠标，你可以绕着它走一圈；推动滚轮，塔楼的影子就近在脚边。没有固定的路线，只有你自己的视线。
scenes.text_en: Drag the mouse and you can circle it; scroll and the shadow of the towers comes to your feet. There is no fixed route — only your own line of sight.

scenes.title: 把城堡剖开
scenes.text: 点开楼层剖面，屋顶与墙面依次退去。藏书层的木地板、四柱床的帷幔、长桌上摊开的卷轴，都留在原来的位置。
scenes.text_en: Open a floor section and roofs and walls peel away. The library's oak floor, the four-poster's canopy, the scrolls spread on the long table — all stay exactly where they belong.

scenes.title: 九个房间，九种光线
scenes.text: 九个房间，九种光线。每一间都有一份自己的档案：楼层、朝向、陈设数量，以及它为什么被安排在这里。
scenes.text_en: Nine rooms, nine kinds of light. Each has its own dossier: level, orientation, how many pieces it holds, and why it was placed there.

scenes.title: 沿垂直轴展开
scenes.text: 打开分层展开，城堡沿着垂直轴缓缓升起。三层结构像一页摊开的手稿，一层一层，请你走进去看。
scenes.text_en: Turn on the exploded view and the castle rises along its vertical axis. Three storeys unfold like a manuscript, one layer at a time, inviting you in.

scenes.title: 两座对称的庭园
scenes.text: 南向的晨露露台，是从卧室直接走进花园的一扇门。两座镜像的庭园，喷泉在中央，玫瑰拱廊围住整个午后。
scenes.text_en: The south-facing morning balcony is a door straight from the bedchamber into the garden. Two mirrored parterres, a fountain at the centre, a rose arcade holding the whole afternoon.

scenes.title: 可以被复核的建造
scenes.text: 七十九件陈设，逐件核对它们与墙的距离。没有一件穿墙，没有一件越界——这是一次可以被复核的建造。
scenes.text_en: Seventy-nine furnishings, each measured against its walls. Not one passes through stone, not one steps out of bounds — a build that can be audited.

scenes.title: 一日之光
scenes.text: 拖动时间轴，太阳从黎明走到子夜。窗子先亮，然后是壁炉、灯柱，和满天星光。同一座城堡，一夜之间换了三次心情。
scenes.text_en: Drag the timeline and the sun travels from dawn to midnight. The windows light first, then the hearths, the lamp posts and a sky full of stars. The same castle, changing its mood three times in a night.

scenes.title: 把它带走
scenes.text: 如果愿意，就把它带走。一个不到十六兆的模型文件，五百多个网格，五十六万个三角面——可以导进任何三维软件，也可以放进你的下一个项目。
scenes.text_en: If you like, take it with you. A model file under sixteen megabytes, more than five hundred meshes, five hundred sixty-six thousand triangles — ready for any 3D tool, or for your next project.

scenes.title: 光，会在原来的位置等你
scenes.text: 金鸢尾堡。它不在石头里，它在浏览器里。打开它，光就亮了。
scenes.text_en: Castellum Aureliae. It isn't in the stone — it's in the browser. Open it, and the light comes on.
